.. autoapi-nested-parse::

Module Contents

.. py:function:: run_probes(Z, y, config = None)

   Evaluate lightweight probe classifiers on embeddings.

   :param Z: Dense or sparse embedding matrix.
   :param y: Class labels.
   :param config: Probe configuration.

   :returns: Probe result dictionary, or `None` when disabled.
